The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crimelord [[Zodoh]]'s military forces included a '''twin-seater starfighter'''. It was a twin-seater version of the [[Intruder-class starfighter|''Intruder''-class starfighter]].

These starfighters were kept aboard Zodoh's fighter carrier and flagship ''[[Voracious]]'' during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. Following the [[Aquilaris campaign]], the [[Grace Command]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jenn Devaad]] stole one of these fighters during her escape from Zodoh. Later, she flew the starfighter to [[Aquilaris Minor|Aquilaris]] where she picked up [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] and disembarked for [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]].
